pages.text: Frostflower grows on suitable soil or snow and spreads with a local density limit. It releases snow particles and drops itself when harvested.

In a hot powered cauldron, combine a legacy red-flower variant, Perpetual Ice and Liquid Witchcraft. Receive a Frostflower and Empty Jar. Use Poppy, Blue Orchid, Allium, Azure Bluet, a Tulip or Oxeye Daisy; Dandelion is not accepted. Iceworld brews can convert stone and leaves into Perpetual Ice.
